text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a regression on small-batch decode with FlashPaged variants after the kernel-selection tweak yesterday. p95 latency up ~18% on short-chat workloads.

maria: ack, can you paste the bench numbers? which config/threshold changed?

alex: Quick numbers from local microbench (single GPU, 8 concurrent sessions):
```
model: redwood-7b-flashpaged
workload: conv-chat short (avg 12 tokens per request)
before: p50 32ms, p95 78ms, tps 460 tok/s
after:  p50 36ms, p95 92ms, tps 390 tok/s
```
Seems like more decode calls are hitting the prefill kernel fallback path in the new routing.

jia: hmm that throughput drop looks like batching collapse. Are KV cache hits lower? Any coldstart increase?

alex: KV hit ratio dropped from 0.82 -> 0.61 in the trace for these sessions. I think routing is preferring the small-decode kernel that doesn't use the fused KV read path.

sam: Can you share the routing policy change? I touched the threshold that picks "inflight vs prefill" kernels to reduce prefill contention. Maybe the change causes early switch for short prefixes.

alex: here's the relevant config snippet I tested (new default):
```
kernel_select:
  decode_threshold_tokens: 4   # try small-decode kernel below 4
  prefill_inflight_window: 12
  continuous_batching: true
```
I suspect decode_threshold_tokens should be 2 for short-chat PLs.

maria: Also noticed KV page fragmentation in the profile logs. When small-decode runs, it emits many small KV memcpy ops instead of one fused page read. Profiling sample:
```
[profile] kv_read_ops: 128 -> 310
[profile] avg_kv_read_size: 6KB -> 1.5KB
[profile] kernel_launches: +22%
```
That matches the hit ratio deltas.

jia: If the small-decode kernel path can't leverage the fused attention+kv read, that'll blow up launch overhead. Two quick mitigation ideas: 1) prefer prefill kernel for any session with avg prefix >= X (X=6?), 2) restore fused-kv-read support on small-decode (harder).

sam: +1 for a conservative threshold bump. We rolled the change to reduce prefill pressure, but we didn't bad-case for prefix-length distribution.

alex: I ran a targeted A/B on the routing variant that pins decode_threshold_tokens=2. Results: p95 back to 80ms, tps 445 tok/s, KV hit 0.79. So threshold looks like the knob.

maria: Nice. Can you push the AB test to staging with traffic shaped to mimic chat-short heavy? I want end-to-end traces.

alex: Pushed a canary on 10% staging gpus: route flag: kernel_select.decode_threshold_tokens=2. CI-bot shows deploy succeeded.

ci-bot: Deploy to staging (canary 10%) succeeded — 4/4 hosts healthy.

jia: I'll instrument a microtrace that shows kernel name per token and capture KV read sizes. Will run within the next hour.

sam: If the canary holds, we should patch default back to 2 and add a unit test asserting no >10% p95 regression for avg-prefix 8 workload. Also add logging to catch low-KV-hit sessions for 24h.

maria: Also add a metric: small_decode_fused_kv_enabled boolean per model variant so we can see where fused path is available.

alex: Agreed. I'll open a PR for the config change + test. Title: "router: tighten small-decode threshold for short-chat perf". Assigning to me + jia for metrics.

jia: FYI I ran a quick flame on the after-case — kernel-launch overhead is the top line, not matmul. snippet:
```
flame: 45% kernel_launch, 30% attention_compute, 12% kv_copy, 13% others
```
So reducing kernel launches by preferring prefill wins.

sam: Good data. If someone wants to try the harder route of keeping threshold but adding fused-kv into small-decode, that could give perf wins for mid-prefix workloads. But schedule that after this rollback; it's a larger engineering lift.

maria: Action list:
- alex: PR to change default threshold -> 2 + unit test (ETA EOD)
- jia: add microtrace + metric + run canary trace (ETA 1h)
- sam: backlog a small-decode fused-kv work item (sprint 32)
- alex/maria: monitor KV-hit and p95 for 24h post-change

alex: created PR #3842, linking bench logs and before/after traces. Will merge on green.

maria: Thanks. If canary looks green after 2h we can promote. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: PR #3842 passed CI checks (unit + integration).

jia: canary traces show p95 down to target and KV-hit stable. I'll post the trace links in eng-runtime channel after I scrub PII.

alex: merging now. rolling default to stable.

sam: nice catch — lesson: routing heuristics need prefix-distribution tests in the rollout checklist.

maria: Agreed. I'll add a checklist item to the kernel-routing playbook.

alex: closing thread when metrics look healthy, thanks everyone.
